Total revenue increased at a modest pace, driven primarily by strong performance in the company\u2019s core markets. As a result, gross profit grew at a stable rate, keeping in line with management\u2019s expectations. The company managed to reduce its financial leverage, leading to an improvement in its interest coverage ratio.
